source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 9 (PDF 207-225), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Entrepreneurship in Digital Age) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
9.1 Introduction to Design Thinking and Business Solutions

blocks.prompt:
1 The chapter presents Design Thinking as a:
(Chapter Design Thinking ko kya bata kar pesh karta hai?)

options.text: kaarobari hal banane ka insan-markazi tareeqa

blocks.explanation: 9.1 (Introduction): Design Thinking ko kaarobari masail ke hal ka insan-markazi (human-centered) tareeqa kaha gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: emphasizing Design Thinking as a human-centered approach to developing effective business solutions

blocks.text: 9.1.1 Design Thinking (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test)

blocks.prompt:
2 How many key steps does the Design Thinking method have?
(Design Thinking ke kitne ahem qadam hain?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.1: Design Thinking ke paanch qadam hain: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype aur Test.

book_ref.quote: This method involves five key steps: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, and Test

blocks.prompt:
3 Instead of jumping straight to solutions, Design Thinking first encourages us to:
(Seedha hal ki taraf jane ke bajaye Design Thinking pehle kya karne par zor deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.1: Design Thinking masle ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhti hai aur pehle masle ko gehrai se samajhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Instead of just jumping to solutions, Design Thinking encourages us to first understand the problem deeply

blocks.prompt:
4 Talking to students to learn what they like and dislike about their current school bags belongs to which step?
(Students se baat kar ke jaanna ke unhein apne mojooda bag mein kya pasand ya na-pasand hai, kis qadam mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.1: Empathize ka matlab hai khud ko doosre ki jagah rakh kar us ke ehsasat, zarooraton aur mushkilat ko samajhna.

book_ref.quote: This means putting yourself in someone else's shoes

blocks.prompt:
5 Writing the statement 'Students need a lightweight, durable, and spacious bag that is comfortable to carry' is the step:
(Yeh jumla likhna ke 'Students ko halka, mazboot aur kushada bag chahiye jo uthane mein aaram deh ho' kaun sa qadam hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.1: maloomat jama karne ke baad Define ke qadam mein masla wazeh likha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: After gathering information, the next step is to clearly define the problem

blocks.prompt:
6 Brainstorming all possible solutions without worrying whether they are perfect is called:
(Har mumkin hal sochna baghair yeh fikr kiye ke woh mukammal hai ya nahi, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.1: Ideate mein khayalat ka toofan (brainstorm) kiya jata hai, jaise padding wala ya khanon wala bag.

book_ref.quote: You can think of all possible solutions without worrying if they are perfect

blocks.prompt:
7 A simple version of an idea that can be created quickly, e.g. a basic bag model of cardboard or fabric, is a:
(Khayal ka aisa saada namoona jo jaldi ban sake, jaise gatte ya kapre ka bag model, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.1: prototype khayal ka saada namoona hai jo jaldi banaya ja sake.

book_ref.quote: A prototype is a simple version of your idea that you can create quickly

blocks.prompt:
8 In the Test step of Design Thinking you:
(Design Thinking ke Test qadam mein aap kya karte hain?)

options.text: users se prototype istemal karwa kar raye le kar behtar karte hain
product ke liye loan lete hain
raye lena band kar dete hain

blocks.explanation: 9.1.1: prototype ko test karte hain, users se istemal karwa kar raye lete hain aur behtar karte rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Finally, you test your prototype to see if it works well

blocks.prompt:
9 A grocery store's items are often out of stock, so it starts using software to track inventory. This is an example of a:
(Grocery store ki cheezein aksar khatam ho jati hain, is liye woh inventory track karne ka software lagata hai. Yeh kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.2: business solutions companies ko masail hal karne aur behtar kaam karne mein madad dete hain, jaise inventory software.

book_ref.quote: Business solutions are ways to help companies solve problems and work better

blocks.prompt:
10 If more customers start shopping online, the book suggests a store might:
(Agar zyada customers online khareedari karne lagein to kitab ke mutabiq store kya kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.1.2: business solutions kaarobar ko barhate bhi hain; jaise online khareedne walon ke liye home delivery.

book_ref.quote: you might offer home delivery services to meet their needs

blocks.text: 9.1.3 How Does Design Thinking Apply to Business Solutions?

blocks.prompt:
11 A company uses Design Thinking to build an app that makes ordering food online easier. Its success comes from:
(Company Design Thinking se online khana mangwane ki aasan app banati hai. Is ki kamyabi kis cheez se hai?)

options.text: waqt bachane ke liye testing chhorna
user ke tajurbe par tawajjuh aur mukhtalif khayalat ki testing

blocks.explanation: 9.1.3: user ke tajurbe par tawajjuh aur mukhtalif khayalat test kar ke company aasan aur kamyab hal banati hai.

book_ref.quote: By focusing on the user's experience and testing different ideas

blocks.prompt:
12 The book compares a business plan to a:
(Kitab business plan ko kis cheez se tashbeeh deti hai?)

options.text: kaarobar shuru karne aur chalane ka naqsha

blocks.explanation: 9.2: business plan kaarobar shuru karne aur chalane ka naqsha hai.

book_ref.quote: A business plan is like a map for starting and running a business

blocks.prompt:
13 A document that describes your business idea, how you plan to make it successful and the steps to reach your goals is a:
(Woh document jo aap ka kaarobari khayal, use kamyab banane ka mansooba aur maqasid tak pohanchne ke qadam bayan kare:)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.1: business plan woh document hai jo kaarobari khayal, kamyabi ka mansooba aur maqasid ke qadam bayan karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A business plan is a document that describes your business idea

blocks.text: 9.2.2 Key Parts of a Business Plan

blocks.prompt:
14 The brief overview of a business plan that captures its most important points is the:
(Business plan ka mukhtasar jaiza jo is ke ahem tareen nukaat samete, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.2: Executive Summary mukhtasar jaiza hai: kaarobar kya karta hai, us ke maqasid aur unhein kaise hasil karega.

book_ref.quote: Think of it as a summary that captures the most important points of your plan

blocks.prompt:
15 Finding out how many pet owners live in your area and which other pet-sitting services exist belongs to:
(Yeh maloom karna ke aap ke ilaqe mein kitne pet owners hain aur kaun si doosri pet-sitting services hain, kis hisse mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.2: Market Analysis mein mumkina customers, un ki zarooratein aur muqabil talash kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: find out how many pet owners are in your area and what other pet-sitting services are available

blocks.prompt:
16 Describing team members and their roles, such as the president and secretary of a school club, belongs to:
(Team members aur un ke kirdar, jaise school club ka president aur secretary, bayan karna kis hisse mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.2: Organization and Management batata hai ke kaarobar kaise munazzam hoga, team members aur un ke kirdar.

book_ref.quote: explain who will be the president, secretary, and other roles

blocks.prompt:
17 The section of a business plan that details how you will attract and keep customers is:
(Business plan ka kaun sa hissa batata hai ke aap customers kaise layenge aur barqarar rakhenge?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.2: Marketing and Sales Strategy mein marketing ke tareeqe aur bechne ki tactics hoti hain, jaise crafts ke liye social media aur mele.

book_ref.quote: This section details how you will attract and keep customers

blocks.prompt:
18 Details about the budget, funding needs and expected revenue are included in the:
(Budget, funding ki zaroorat aur mutawaqqa aamdani ki tafseel kis hisse mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.2: Financial Plan maali maqasid, budget, funding ki zaroorat aur mutawaqqa aamdani bayan karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Include details about your budget, funding needs, and expected revenue

blocks.prompt:
19 'Our chai dhaba will offer freshly brewed chai ... near the local bazaar.' This sentence is from which part of a business plan?
('Hamara chai dhaba taaza chai ... local bazaar ke qareeb.' Yeh jumla business plan ke kis hisse ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.2: kitab yeh chai dhaba wala jumla Business Description ki misal ke taur par deti hai: kya pesh hoga aur kahan.

book_ref.quote: Our chai dhaba will offer freshly brewed chai using high-quality tea leaves

blocks.text: 9.2.3 Using Digital Tools to Create a Business Plan

blocks.prompt:
20 PlanGuru and Enloop are examples of:
(PlanGuru aur Enloop kis ki misalein hain?)

options.text: mil kar kaam karne ke document tools

blocks.explanation: 9.2.3.1: PlanGuru ya Enloop jaise business plan software templates dete aur hisson ki rehnumai karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Using business plan software like PlanGuru or Enloop

blocks.prompt:
21 After you input costs for inventory, website and marketing, business plan software generates:
(Inventory, website aur marketing ke kharche dalne ke baad business plan software kya banata hai?)

options.text: andazan sales aur cash flow jaisi financial projections, charts aur graphs ke saath

blocks.explanation: 9.2.3.1: financial calculators kharche lete hain aur software andazan sales aur cash flow jaisi projections charts aur graphs ke saath banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The software then generates financial projections, such as estimated sales and cash flow

blocks.prompt:
22 Two partners writing different sections of the same business plan at the same time can use:
(Do partners aik hi business plan ke mukhtalif hisse aik waqt mein likhne ke liye kya istemal kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.3.2: Google Drive ya Dropbox Paper jaise tools dono partners ko aik hi document par aik saath kaam karne dete hain.

book_ref.quote: you can use tools like Google Drive or Dropbox Paper

blocks.prompt:
23 The feature of collaborative tools that tracks changes and lets you go back to an earlier draft is:
(Collaborative tools ki woh khoobi jo tabdeeliyan track kare aur pichhle draft par wapas jane de:)
blocks.explanation: 9.2.3.2: version control tabdeeliyan track karta hai aur zaroorat par pichhle draft par wapas le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: version control features help you track changes and revert to earlier drafts

blocks.prompt:
24 Commenting and suggestion modes in collaborative tools let team members:
(Collaborative tools ke commenting aur suggestion modes team members ko kya karne dete hain?)

options.text: asal text badle baghair raye ya tabdeeli ki tajweez dena

blocks.explanation: 9.2.3.2: commenting aur suggestion modes asal text badle baghair raye ya tabdeeli ki tajweez dene dete hain.

book_ref.quote: where team members can leave feedback or propose changes without altering the original text

blocks.prompt:
25 Collecting market insights involves gathering and analyzing information about:
(Market insights jama karne mein kin cheezon ki maloomat jama aur tajziya ki jati hai?)

options.text: target customers, muqabil aur poore market ka mahol

blocks.explanation: 9.3: market insights mein target customers, muqabil aur poore market ke mahol ki maloomat jama aur tajziya ki jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Collecting market insights involves gathering and analyzing information about your target customers

blocks.prompt:
26 The process of gathering data about the market in which your business operates is called:
(Us market ka data jama karna jis mein aap ka kaarobar chalta hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.1: market research market ka data jama karti hai taake customers ki zarooratein aur muqabilon ki taqat aur kamzori samjhi ja sake.

book_ref.quote: Market research is the process of gathering data about the market in which your business operates

blocks.prompt:
27 Research that collects non-numerical data through interviews, focus groups and observations is:
(Woh research jo interviews, focus groups aur mushahide se ghair-adadi data jama kare:)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.1.1: qualitative research wajoohat, aara aur muharrikat samajhti hai aur ghair-adadi data jama karti hai.

book_ref.quote: It involves collecting non-numerical data through methods such as interviews, focus groups, and observations

blocks.prompt:
28 A survey to find how often people buy coffee and how much they will pay for it is an example of:
(Survey jo maloom kare ke log kitni dafa coffee khareedte hain aur kitna dene ko tayyar hain, kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.1.1: quantitative research adadi data jama karti hai jo naapa aur statistically parkha ja sake; is se qeemat aur sales ka andaza hota hai.

book_ref.quote: quantitative research involves collecting numerical data that can be measured and analyzed statistically

blocks.prompt:
29 Quantitative research is especially useful for:
(Quantitative research khaas taur par kis kaam aati hai?)

options.text: customers ke rawaiye mein patterns aur trends pehchanna

blocks.explanation: 9.3.1.1: quantitative research customers ke rawaiye mein patterns aur trends pehchanne ke liye mufeed hai.

book_ref.quote: This type of research is useful for identifying patterns and trends in customer behavior

blocks.prompt:
30 Which tool is best for gathering information from a large number of customers, online, by phone or in person?
(Bari tadad mein customers se online, phone par ya aamne saamne maloomat jama karne ka behtareen tool kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.1.2: surveys bari tadad mein customers se maloomat jama karne ka taqatwar tool hain; online, phone ya aamne saamne.

book_ref.quote: Surveys are a powerful tool for gathering information from a large number of customers

blocks.prompt:
31 A small, diverse set of people brought together for detailed discussion about a product is a:
(Chhota aur mukhtalif logon ka group jo kisi product par tafseeli guftagu ke liye ikattha ho:)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.1.2: focus group chhota aur mukhtalif logon ka group hai jo product, service ya concept par tafseel se baat karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A focus group consists of a small, diverse set of individuals

blocks.prompt:
32 The primary objective of a focus group is to:
(Focus group ka bunyadi maqsad kya hai?)

options.text: customers ki aara aur rawaiyon ko poori tarah samajhna

blocks.explanation: 9.3.1.2: focus group ka maqsad customers ki aara aur rawaiyon ko poori tarah samajhna hai; is se qualitative data milta hai.

book_ref.quote: The primary objective is to obtain a comprehensive understanding of customer opinions and attitudes

blocks.prompt:
33 Survey data show that most bakery purchases occur on weekends. According to the book, this pattern suggests:
(Survey data batata hai ke bakery ki zyada khareedari weekends par hoti hai. Kitab ke mutabiq yeh pattern kya batata hai?)

options.text: marketing ya khaas promotions weekends par karna

blocks.explanation: 9.3.2: weekend wala pattern batata hai ke marketing ya khaas promotions weekends par karein taake sales barhein.

book_ref.quote: the data will likely show that most purchases occur on weekends

blocks.prompt:
34 Breaking a larger target market into smaller groups based on age, income or buying habits is called:
(Bari target market ko umar, aamdani ya khareedne ki aadaton ki bunyad par chhote groups mein baantna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.2: market segmentation bari market ko umar, aamdani ya aadaton ki bunyad par chhote groups mein baantna hai.

book_ref.quote: Market segmentation is the process of breaking down a larger target market into smaller

blocks.prompt:
35 A nearby bakery is popular for artisanal bread, so you add gourmet pastries to attract a different group. This decision comes from:
(Qareeb ki bakery artisanal bread ke liye mashhoor hai, is liye aap gourmet pastries shamil karte hain. Yeh faisla kis se aaya?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.2: competitor analysis muqabilon ki taqat, kamzori, qeematon aur feedback ko dekh kar apne kaarobar ko mukhtalif banane ke mauqe dhoondta hai.

book_ref.quote: By studying competitors' strengths and weaknesses, pricing strategies, and customer feedback

blocks.prompt:
36 Using historical sales data to forecast that demand for a product will keep rising is:
(Purane sales data se andaza lagana ke kisi product ki demand barhti rahegi, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.2: predictive analysis purane data se mustaqbil ke trends aur nataij ka andaza lagata hai.

book_ref.quote: Predictive analysis uses historical data to forecast future trends and outcomes

blocks.prompt:
37 If data shows that a product is underperforming, a data-driven decision could be to:
(Agar data batata hai ke koi product kamzor chal raha hai to data par mabni faisla kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: use band kar ke kamyab products par tawajjuh dena

blocks.explanation: 9.3.2: product kamzor chale to use band kar ke kamyab products par tawajjuh dena resources ka behtar istemal hai.

book_ref.quote: you may decide to discontinue it and focus on more successful products

blocks.prompt:
38 A short presentation in which you explain your business idea is a:
(Mukhtasar presentation jis mein aap apna kaarobari khayal samjhate hain, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.3: business pitch mukhtasar presentation hai jis mein kaarobari khayal samjhaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A business pitch is a short presentation where you explain your business idea

blocks.prompt:
39 In the juice shop pitch, 'There are no other juice shops nearby, and people are becoming more health-conscious' answers:
(Juice shop pitch mein 'qareeb koi aur juice shop nahi aur log sehat ka zyada khayal rakhne lage hain' kis sawal ka jawab hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.3: pitch mein khayal kya hai, customers kaun hain aur yeh kyun chalega shamil hota hai; yeh jumla 'kyun chalega' batata hai.

book_ref.quote: There are no other juice shops nearby, and people are becoming more health-conscious

blocks.prompt:
40 According to the book, famous companies like Apple and Google started with:
(Kitab ke mutabiq Apple aur Google jaisi mashhoor companies kis cheez se shuru huin?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.3 (Did You Know?): Apple aur Google saada business pitches se shuru huin; baniyon ne support aur sarmaya lene ke liye khayal wazeh samjhaya.

book_ref.quote: The founders had to explain their ideas clearly to get support and investment

blocks.prompt:
41 According to the steps to pitching your idea, the pitch should begin with:
(Pitch ke qadmon ke mutabiq pitch kis se shuru honi chahiye?)

options.text: woh masla jo aap ka khayal hal karega

blocks.explanation: 9.3.4: pehle masla, phir hal, phir is ki inferadiyat, audience ko jaanna aur sawalon ke liye tayyar rehna.

book_ref.quote: Begin by explaining the problem that your business idea will solve

blocks.prompt:
42 When pitching to investors rather than customers, you should mainly explain:
(Customers ke bajaye investors ko pitch karte waqt zyada tar kya samjhana chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.4 (Know Your Audience): customers ko batayein unhein product kyun pasand aayega; investors ko batayein kaarobar paisa kaise kamayega.

book_ref.quote: If you're talking to investors, explain how your shop will make money

blocks.prompt:
43 In the web development pitch, 'tailored for small businesses, with easy-to-use designs and local language support' is the:
(Web development pitch mein 'chhote kaarobar ke liye, aasan designs aur maqami zaban ki support' kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.4: web development pitch mein yeh jumla Unique Selling Point (khaas khoobi) hai.

book_ref.quote: with easy-to-use designs and local language support

blocks.prompt:
44 In the web development pitch, local shop owners and restaurant managers who want an online presence are the:
(Web development pitch mein local dukaan dar aur restaurant managers jo online maujoodgi chahte hain, kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: 9.3.4: web development service ki Target Audience local dukaan dar aur restaurant managers hain.

book_ref.quote: Our target customers are local shop owners and restaurant managers

blocks.prompt:
45 Being able to pitch your idea is important mainly because it:
(Apna khayal pitch kar sakna zyada tar kyun ahem hai?)

options.text: business plan ki zaroorat khatam karti hai
khayal ko haqeeqat banane ke liye zaroori support dilati hai
market research ki jagah leti hai

blocks.explanation: 9.3.5: pitch se woh support milti hai jo khayal ko haqeeqat banane ke liye chahiye; achhi pitch bara farq daalti hai.

book_ref.quote: it helps you get the support you need to turn your idea into reality

blocks.text: 9.4 Developing Effective Marketing and Sales Strategies

blocks.prompt:
46 According to the book, marketing and sales help businesses to:
(Kitab ke mutabiq marketing aur sales kaarobar ki kya madad karti hain?)

options.text: customers laana, sales barhana aur brand barhana

blocks.explanation: 9.4: marketing aur sales customers laane, sales barhane aur brand ko barhane mein madad karti hain.

book_ref.quote: They help businesses attract customers, increase sales, and grow their brand

blocks.prompt:
47 For a business selling traditional Pakistani clothing, the book's target market is:
(Riwayati Pakistani kapre bechne wale kaarobar ki kitab ke mutabiq target market kya hai?)

options.text: Eid ya shaadiyon ki tayyari karne wale log

blocks.explanation: 9.4.1: market samajhne ka matlab customers aur zarooratein pehchanna hai; riwayati kapron ki market Eid ya shaadiyon ki tayyari wale log hain.

book_ref.quote: your target market includes individuals preparing for Eid or weddings

blocks.prompt:
48 Choosing promotional channels such as social media, television or word-of-mouth is part of a:
(Social media, television ya zubani tashheer jaise channels chunna kis cheez ka hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.4.2: marketing plan target market tak pohanchne ki strategies aur tashheer ke channels ka intikhab bayan karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It includes selecting promotional channels, such as social media, television, or word-of-mouth

blocks.prompt:
49 For launching a new brand of Pakistani spices, the book suggests:
(Pakistani masalon ke naye brand ke liye kitab kya tajweez karti hai?)

options.text: cooking shows ya khanon wale social media influencers ke saath ishtehar

blocks.explanation: 9.4.2: cooking shows par ishtehar ya Pakistani khanon wale social media influencers ke saath kaam mufeed hoga.

book_ref.quote: collaborating with social media influencers who focus on traditional Pakistani cuisine

blocks.prompt:
50 Offering discounts, running promotions and giving excellent customer service are examples of:
(Discount dena, promotions chalana aur behtareen customer service dena kis ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: 9.4.3: sales strategies customers ko khareedne par amada karne ki tactics hain, jaise discount, promotions ya achhi service.

book_ref.quote: Sales strategies are tactics used to convince customers to purchase your product

blocks.prompt:
51 Special deals on food items in grocery stores during Ramadan mainly encourage people to:
(Ramazan mein grocery stores ki khaas deals zyada tar logon ko kis baat par amada karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: 9.4.3: Ramazan mein grocery stores ki khaas deals logon ko zyada miqdar mein khareedne par amada karti hain.

book_ref.quote: many grocery stores in Pakistan offer special deals on food items

blocks.prompt:
52 A business selling water purifiers in Karachi focuses on the need for clean drinking water especially:
(Karachi mein water purifier bechne wala kaarobar saaf peene ke paani ki zaroorat par khaas taur par kab tawajjuh deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.4.4: customer ki zaroorat samajhna: Karachi ka kaarobar saaf paani par khaas taur par garmiyon mein zor deta hai jab paani ka mayaar masla hota hai.

book_ref.quote: especially during the hot summer months when water quality can be a concern

blocks.prompt:
53 The Lahore start-up selling handmade jewelry online increases its sales by:
(Lahore ka start-up jo online haath ke bane zewar bechta hai, apni sales kaise barhata hai?)

options.text: shaadiyon ke season mein band ho kar
shaadiyon ke season mein mehdood waqt ke discounts de kar
sirf aik dukaan mein bech kar
apne social media pages hata kar

blocks.explanation: 9.4.4: start-up Instagram aur Facebook, local influencers aur shaadiyon ke season mein mehdood waqt ke discounts istemal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: By offering limited-time discounts during the wedding season, the start-up increases its sales

blocks.prompt:
54 A shop sells 250 school bags at Rs. 400 each. Its revenue is:
(Dukaan 250 school bags Rs. 400 fi bag bechti hai. Is ki revenue (aamdani) kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.5.1: revenue = bechi gayi tadad x qeemat = 250 x 400 = Rs. 100,000.

book_ref.quote: Revenue is the total amount of money a business earns from selling goods or services

blocks.prompt:
55 A shop's revenue is Rs. 100,000 and its total costs are Rs. 65,000. Its profit is:
(Dukaan ki revenue Rs. 100,000 aur kul kharche Rs. 65,000 hain. Is ka munafa kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.5.1: munafa = revenue - kharche = 100,000 - 65,000 = Rs. 35,000.

book_ref.quote: Profit, on the other hand, is the money left after subtracting all the costs of running the business

blocks.prompt:
56 Why is it hard to track the true size of Pakistan's economy, according to the book?
(Kitab ke mutabiq Pakistan ki maeeshat ka asal size jaanna mushkil kyun hai?)

options.text: Ghair rasmi shobe ke bohat se chhote kaarobar aamdani aur munafa hamesha nahi batate

blocks.explanation: 9.5.1 (Did You Know?): bohat se chhote kaarobar ghair rasmi shobe mein hain aur apni aamdani aur munafa hukoomat ko hamesha nahi batate.

book_ref.quote: they don't always report their revenue and profit to the government

blocks.prompt:
57 Allocating funds to a business or project with the aim of generating future profit is called:
(Mustaqbil ke munafe ke liye kisi kaarobar ya project mein raqam lagana kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 9.5.2: investment (sarmaya kari) mustaqbil ke munafe ke liye raqam lagana hai, jaise store ka naya maal khareedna.

book_ref.quote: Investment involves allocating funds to a business or project with the aim of generating future profit

blocks.prompt:
58 A restaurant sets aside Rs. 15,000 each month for 12 months to buy a new oven. How much does it save?
